title: [DECISION] FIPS gate called first in all entry points
description: Every externally-callable function in wolfssl_rsa.c, wolfssl_ecdh.c, wolfssl_ecdsa.c calls wolfssl_fips_gate() as its first executable statement, before argument validation and before any wolfCrypt call. wolfssl_ec_key_free intentionally skips the gate (cleanup must always proceed — documented in comment). Correct implementation of the FIPS 140-3 operational requirement. wolfssl_ec_key_import and wolfssl_ec_key_generate correctly require callers (the per-algo wrappers) to check the gate.
